name: Infused
description: Yellow bile runs hot in you. You deal {value}% more damage.

name: Choleric
description: Your temper leaves you open. You take {value}% more damage.

name: Warding
description: Black bile settles cold around you. You take {value}% less damage.

name: Melancholic
description: The cold dulls your hand. You deal {value}% less damage.

name: Ward
description: Wrapped in black bile. You take {value}% less damage.

name: Fervour
description: Burning with purpose. You deal {value}% more damage.

name: Bleeding
description: You have {value} blood still to lose, a little each tick.

name: Scars
description: {value} scars. At ten, your next ultimate costs no phlegm.

name: Siphon
description: {value}% of the damage you deal comes back to you as blood.

name: Abjuration
description: Your abilities do four times their damage to the occult-made, and none to anything else.

name: Death's Dance
description: Hits you take are {value}% lighter now; you bleed out the difference afterwards.

name: Hemospike
description: Builders give {value} more phlegm, and every ability costs you blood.

name: Redemption
description: The next blow you take is stopped completely, and paid back in phlegm.

name: Martyrdom
description: Every wound you take leaves a scar.

name: Stigmata
description: While you're below 30% blood you deal {value}% more damage.
